exposure: lack of training about pediatric vaccines in antenatal follow-up
following anti-vaccine groups on social media
irregular or no use of vitamin D and iron supplements for the child
worry about vaccine ingredients (aluminum, mercury, pig gelatine)
cohort: The study included 370 parents, specifically females with children aged 12 months to 6 years, who were receiving service from the antenatal class of a tertiary hospital in Turkey.
finding: The prevalence of vaccine hesitancy was 13.8%, and significant risk factors included pregnancies with treatment, not using vitamin D or iron preparations, following anti-vaccine social media groups, and worrying about vaccine ingredients.
cross-section timing: Parents of children aged 12 months to 6 years
